Here is the transcription of the Latin marriage register from `image_ef10e8.png`. The entries are organized by page (Left Page / Page 54 and Right Page / Page 55) and ordered chronologically as they appear.

Due to the historical handwriting and localized ink fading, some standard Latin abbreviations have been expanded or noted for clarity (e.g., *Mat:º junxi* for *Matrimonio junxi*—"I joined in marriage").

## Left Page (1854)

### Entry 1: July 30

> **Juli 30** Jacobum Neligan et Helenam Connell de Ballyneen Mat. junxi coram Catharina Connell et Honora Walsh.
> *Laur. Harnett*

### Entry 2: July 30

> **Juli 30** Thomam Whelan & Helenam Power de Croom [---] junxi coram Pat. Fitzgerald & Elizabeth Moylan.
> *Jo[hanne]s Hayes V.P.*

### Entry 3: August 13

> **13.** Patricium Quain et Catharinam Quain de Croom Mat:º junxit Rev.dus Jacobus Shea Vicarius. Coram Michaeli Walsh & Margarita Fox.
> *Laur. Harnett*

### Entry 4: September 6

> **6 Septembris** Edvandum Sullivan et Johannam Hogan de Croom Mat. junxi coram Ricardo Punch et Maria Smith.
> *Laur. Harnett*

### Entry 5: September 14

> **14.** Jacobum O'Donnell et Brigidam Minahan Mat:º junxit Rev.dus Jacobus Shea Vicarius, Coram Mauritio Hogan et Maria Hogan.

### Entry 6: September 30

> **30** Gulielmum Reed & Helenam Ryan de Ballyculhane cum Parochi licentia Mat:º junxi coram Daniele & Hellena Noonan.
> *Jo[hanne]s Hayes V.P.*

### Entry 7: October 5

> **5 Octobris** Thomam Minahan & Mariam O'Brien Matrimonio junxit Rev.dus Jacobus Shea Vicarius. Coram Matthaeo Molony & Maria Minahan.
> *Laur. Harnett*

### Entry 8: November 15

> **Nov:bris 15** Patricium Kirby et Catharinam Shitch Matrimonio junxit Rev.dus Jacobus Shea Vicarius, Coram Joanne Gleeson & Katharina Connell.
> *Laur. Harnett*

### Entry 9: December 21

> **21 Decembris** Vi dispensationis, tam in bannis quam in tempore clauso necnon et in impedimento cognationis spiritualis, ab Ordinario obtenta Matrimonio junxit Reverendus Jacobus Shea Vicarius. Coram Thoma Danaher et Maria & Brigida Danaher, Michaele Delige et Maria Danaher de Croom.
> *Laur. Harnett*
